          type: string

          title: Title

          type: string

          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:

          description: The long error message.
          type: string

          readOnly: true
        timestamp:

          type: array

    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'MR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Retained for backward
            compatibility: an owner may instead supply the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields, which are preferred when
            present. On create it is normalized. Either a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or this flat 'address' must be supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) the structured fields are preferred over the flat
            'address'. It is normalized on create exactly like 'address', and the
            normalized value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. a
            unit or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form the
            composed 'address'. The normalized value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present; a number in national trunk form (a
            leading '0') is treated as Australian, so the '0' is dropped and country
            code '+61' prepended (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'),
            while any other bare number is treated as NANP and country code '+1'
            prepended. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and its
            national-number length must match the country code ('+61' requires 9
            national digits, '+1' requires 10); otherwise the request is rejected
            with 400. The stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per a fixed table keyed by the city's
            region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099); a postcode out of range for the city's
            region is rejected with 400. A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. It is optional: an owner created without a postcode
            is still accepted. When given it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint accepted only when creating an owner. The household is
            keyed on (last name, postcode), so a second owner in an existing
            household is rejected as a household duplicate with 409 unless this flag
            is set, in which case the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. This flag is never persisted
            or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this pet owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by
                a single space ('<title> <lastName>'), or just the last name when
                no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'MR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes from
                the left (e.g. '+61412345678' is shown as '+61 412 345 678').
                The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (or
                'UNKNOWN' when it resolves no region) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration
                date (fiscal year starts 1 July, named by the year it ends in;
                e.g. a 2026-08-09 registration yields 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M20'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the owner's household: the
                first twelve upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized last name (trimmed, collapsed whitespace, lower-cased)
                joined by '|' to the postcode. Owners sharing a last name and
                postcode therefore share the same value automatically. It forms the
                household component of the 'identityKey'. Absent when the owner has
                no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an
                email is present, plus 1 when the owner's namesakeCount is 0,
                plus 2 when the owner belongs to a household of three or more
                members, plus 3 when the owner's tenure (elapsed fiscal years
                since its registration date) exceeds one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level, derived from its
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more
                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, taken from the REGION component of the
                owner's customerCode (the region derived from the postcode);
                'UNKNOWN' when no customer code or region is present.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from its locality (region)
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW ->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD ->
                Australia/Brisbane. Absent when the region is unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether an unusually high number of owners have been created today.
                True once more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                current business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city is approaching the per-city capacity limit
                of 50 owners. True when the city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners (inclusive); otherwise false. The hard rejection at 50 is
                unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel for the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birth date is present.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year it ends in, so a registrationDate
                on or after 1 July belongs to the next year's fiscal year
                (e.g. 2026-08-09 -> 'FY27'). Absent when no registration date is
                present.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the full lower-case hex
                SHA-256 digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'.
                A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when this whole key
                equals that of an existing owner; because the normalized telephone
                is part of the key, two members of the same household with different
                telephones have different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                flagged at creation as a possible duplicate of an existing owner
                because it shares that owner's soundex(lastName) and postcode while
                producing a different identity key. False when no such match exists.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (shared last name and postcode, different telephone).
                Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false. DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while
                retaining the record, and the create endpoint's duplicate and
                identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'MR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Retained for backward
            compatibility: an owner may instead supply the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields, which are preferred when
            present. On create it is normalized. Either a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or this flat 'address' must be supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) the structured fields are preferred over the flat
            'address'. It is normalized on create exactly like 'address', and the
            normalized value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. a
            unit or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            normalized 'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form the
            composed 'address'. The normalized value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present; a number in national trunk form (a
            leading '0') is treated as Australian, so the '0' is dropped and country
            code '+61' prepended (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'),
            while any other bare number is treated as NANP and country code '+1'
            prepended. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+', and its
            national-number length must match the country code ('+61' requires 9
            national digits, '+1' requires 10); otherwise the request is rejected
            with 400. The stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:

              readOnly: true

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `checkDigit` field.

**Changes made:**

- **`model/Owner.java`** — Replaced the `customer_code` and `membership_number` columns/fields (and their accessors) with a single `member_id` / `memberId`.

- **DB schemas** (`h2`, `hsqldb`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — Replaced the two columns with one `member_id` column.

- **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**:
  - New `memberId(...)` helper builds `REGION + FY + HASH8 + CHK`: region from postcode, 2-digit fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date, the same SHA-256-over-(telephone+lastName) first-8-hex, and a Luhn check digit over the digits of `<REGION><FY><HASH8>`.
  - Collision handling (`deduplicatedMemberId`) now applies to the memberId.
  - Removed the old `customerCode`/`deduplicatedCustomerCode`/`membershipNumber` helpers.
  - `primaryIdentifier` now returns the memberId; the human audit line and the structured `OWNER_CREATED` event now carry `memberId`.

- **`mapper/OwnerLocality.java`** — `regionFromMemberId`/`timezoneFromMemberId` derive the region as the leading letter run of the memberId (before the FY digits).

- **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — `locality`/`timezone` now read from the memberId; removed the `checkDigit` mapping. (`memberId` auto-maps by name.)

- **`resources/openapi.yml`** — Removed `customerCode`, `checkDigit`, `membershipNumber`; added `memberId` (drives DTO generation); updated the `locality` description.

The owner segment already references the memberId indirectly (its AREA derives from `locality`, now sourced from the memberId's region), and the fiscal-year value is now embedded in the memberId's FY segment.
